column1: # #1811 pre-child live/claim/stale checks are executable gate steps.
# Owner ruling: https://github.com/cooneycw/claude-power-pack/issues/1811#issuecomment-7065030917
# Exact rendered counts: codex 8768 -> 9060; qwen 9982 -> 10274;
# gemma 10591 -> 10883 (+292 each). No other cap changes.
# #1811 executable gate step: spec-context adds 99 words per driver.
# Owner ruling: https://github.com/cooneycw/claude-power-pack/issues/1811#issuecomment-7065030917
# Existing headroom absorbs 20/22/22 words; caps rise 79/77/77 to exact new counts.
# Word budgets for command documents (issue #1669). One document per line:
# <words><TAB><path under .claude/commands>. Checked by
# `make command-docs-budget-check` (scripts/check-claude-md-budget.py --commands).
# A command document is read in full by every run that invokes it. It holds the
# steps to execute; rationale and incident history belong in a linked reference.
# flow/auto.md: the owner's starting target was 10183 (#1669). The declared
# budget is 10410, argued from measurement and approved by the owner on PR
# #1681: trimmed to 10182, the document had lost or altered 21 instructions
# that no machine check could see (5 found by two counter-model review passes,
# 16 by an independent old-versus-new read). With every one restored, and
# after #1670 removed its mirror-commit steps, it measures 10402. Its fenced
# blocks alone - the commands and report templates - are about 2100 words.
# Every other number is an INTERIM CAP - the document's size when the gate landed - so nothing grows
# while it waits to be trimmed. Owner targets still owed (#1669): flow/register.md
# 8208, flow/wave.md 6954, flow/finish.md 1791. Lower a number when you trim;
# raising one needs a reason in the PR.
# #1809 adds the required delegated approval record, shared exact evidence
# definition, lane review and close-time reporting. The three auto caps grow
# only to the compact procedure counts below; rationale lives in the linked
# delegated-plan-lanes reference. Other caps stay unchanged.
# #1822 offers the helper's four lane answers (adds `will refuse`) and moves an
# open lane to an owner decision before approval: +8 words in the shared core.
# gemma/auto.md and qwen/auto.md grow by exactly that 8, after trimming the
# paragraph; codex/auto.md absorbs it within its cap. Other caps unchanged.
# #1821 tells a delegated run to write lane rows below this run's marker line,
# as the compliance note prints it: +7 words in the shared core after trimming
# the paragraph. The three auto caps grow by exactly 7. Other caps unchanged.
# #1823 makes a lane result a stated outcome with evidence, owes it for `will
# refuse` lanes too, and has a will-test row name its values: +28 words in the
# shared core, so each of the three auto caps grows by exactly 28.
# flow/eli5.md grows by 2: its lane
# sentence says a will-test answer names its values (5 words, 3 absorbed by
# trimming the same paragraph). Other caps unchanged.
# #1847 moves /codex:code_review's six shell blocks into scripts/codex-review-run.sh:
# codex/code_review.md drops to 2593, and flow/auto.md, reading the helper's
# markers instead of carrying them, to 10404. Other caps unchanged.
# #1848 states the missing-helper fallback once and has a stopping helper's own
# CLEAN STOP line relayed instead of restating its exit codes: flow/auto.md
# drops from 10404 to 9929 (475 words). Other caps unchanged.
# #1849 replaces the eight plan-record calls and the hand-built append with
# start / approve --plan / finish: flow/auto.md drops from 9929 to 9816 (113
# words). Other caps unchanged.
# #1850 gives /flow:auto a charter and withdraws, by owner ruling, Step 5
# (documentation), the collapse recipe, the marker-file refusal hand-off and the
# Codex attribution note (moved to ADR 0007), and moves the speckit-context and
# FLOW_CI_* listings to their script references: flow/auto.md drops from 9816 to
# 9120 (696 words), flow/finish.md from 4744 to 4648 (Step 2d), and flow/eli5.md
# absorbs the three Step 3 recommendations within its cap (2653 to 2650).
